verdicts.reason: All rules hold: a program checks each value is a verbatim transcript substring with a locator (A1), assisted matches the brief's 'Assisted to reliable' (A2), MISSING-marking and no smoothing are enforced (A3), all-MISSING is a valid result (A4), and checkRunnable false is honest given the absent line-trace checker (A5).

A3 fails: the done-when only requires the number of fields named in the ask to equal the MISSING count, so an ask that names a filled field in place of an empty one still passes, and the brief's 'ask for that field' is not enforced (a set-equality check against the program's list is needed).

All rules hold: each kept line needs a program-checked verbatim transcript quote with a locator (A1), assisted matches the brief (A2), untraced lines are cut and imported history cannot carry a quote (A3), kept 0 is valid (A4), and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).

All rules hold: a state diff against the cite-passed note is program-readable (A1), gated does not exceed the brief's 'Stop' (A2), present-and-stop with no assessment, plan, or agent signature is enforced and the sign tool is absent (A3), the unchanged note is the valid result (A4), and checkRunnable false is not an overclaim (A5).
